goal_metric: the number this loop exists to move, e.g. 'prod error rate for group X' — not the work it does
effect_probe: how goal_metric is re-measured after a change ships (query or command); '' while undefined
finisher: what closes a work item: merge, resolve, supersede, or escalate; '' while undefined
stop_rule: when to stop or ask a human, e.g. '3 consecutive stalled escalations with no accepted change -> pause and page'
cron: the hermes cron job id that drives this loop
notes: Delete null/'' fields you have not filled in. Adopt an existing cron in one file: point ledger at durable state, list the binaries, wrap the cron's command with: loop tick <this-file> -- <cmd...>
